intro.fallback: Jotaro, after surviving DIO's attempt on his life, surprises the elated DIO by stopping time for the first time, freezing DIO in place and proving that the parallels drawn between their Stands have eluded to a greater…
Jotaro describes the time stop's effect on others, comparing it to drowning and being pushed further down.
He kicks DIO's weakened legs just as time resumes, shattering them completely and sending DIO cascading across the ground.

outro.fallback: The crack in the leg travels up the body, sending a powerful ripple up through The World's figure and shattering it.
The effects of which are mirrored on its user DIO, finally killing him and ending his 100+ year grudge against the Joestar family.
